descriptionHtml:
Bug B23 · P1 · known

Patient cards are missing fields: age shows '76y' not '76F', Hospital cards have no hospital day, Nursing Home cards no visit number

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S03, TC-01/S06, TC-01/S26

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S05 Hospital day: day source × entry date (decision table), with frozen-counter rows that need no aging helper

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 4; UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given seededCensus H1–H7: admit date only (today, −2 d), admit date with a stale stored Hospital Day, Hospital Day only entered 2 days ago, both set and disagreeing, neither, and manual add vs census scan on the same admission day

When Filter the Hospital list to each patient by full name and snapshot the card

Then Each card shows its own hospital day counted in server calendar days: H3 Day 1, H1 Day 3, H2 Day 6 (stored Day 1 is stale), H4 Day 3 (entered Day 1 two days ago), H7 the same day as H3; H5 and H6 are recorded for Q11/Q2

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Decision table, rows → expected: admit date only → days since admission + 1 (Q2); admit date + stale stored day → by date (H2 Day 6); Hospital Day only → entered day + days since entry (H4 Day 3, Q11); both set and disagreeing → no verdict until Q11 (H5); neither → no junk, display per Q2 (H6); manual vs scan same day → identical (H3 = H7, TC-02). …

Where it ran: dev unit U27; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa

No Hospital card shows a hospital day ('Day 1', 'Day 3', 'Day 6'), whether the patient was added today, admitted days ago or scanned in, so the physician cannot see how long anyone has been in.

Evidence: dev U27 (ledger #27). Already in dev report §2 #5 (TFA-92579 AC 3/4; ACs added 10-01 with no PR). H5 (two disagreeing sources) and H6 (no source) were only recorded, for Q11/Q2. The local datasets lane shows the same: no day on any card.

Folded in: local datasets TC-01/S05 (same failure, folded into this result)

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S05
